join.speaker: Relc
join.text: Bones. Old fires, cold a long time. One way out and we're standing in it. Hear that? Something moved back there when we walked in. Big, and it's been down here a good long while. Deep tunnels, huh? You know what lives in deep tunnels? Me. As of today. Come on. Stay behind the spear.

alone_confirm.speaker: Relc
alone_confirm.text: Alone? Ha! You're either very brave or very— actually, no. Just the one thing. Fine. I'll cork the mouth so nothing gets in behind you, and that's every scrap of help you get. What's already in there stays in there with you, and it's bigger than both of us. People walk back out of that. Not many. Shout if you find teeth. Shout early.

options.text: [I'm sure. Hold the door. The rest is mine.]
